assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: main hero photograph for a Saudi food company's Operations page. Primary request: an authentic organized food supply warehouse receiving and stock-control scene, NOT manufacturing. Scene: a clean modern warehouse in Saudi Arabia, neat steel racks with uniformly stacked sealed plain brown cartons and closed unprinted food-ingredient sacks on clean pallets, clear marked pedestrian lane, a receiving area in the foreground. Two warehouse colleagues wearing plain navy workwear, unbranded high-visibility safety vests and suitable safety footwear carefully inspect one incoming pallet of sealed cartons, naturally engaged in checking the physical shipment, no posing for camera, hands anatomically correct. Pallets stable and secured, realistic rack geometry, believable practical working environment. Composition: single portrait 4:5 editorial photograph, medium-wide view with both people fully within the central safe area, warehouse depth visible, generous framing that remains meaningful when cropped to square on mobile. Lighting and style: soft balanced daylight, realistic concrete, cardboard and fabric textures, natural neutral colors with restrained warm tones, credible professional documentary-style photography. Avoid: NO Masdar logo, NO Fonte logo, NO logos or branding of any kind on clothes, walls, cartons or equipment. NO chart displays, NO graphs, NO dashboards, NO visible screens, NO tablets or monitors, NO paperwork presented as charts, NO readable text, NO signage, NO watermarks, NO production line, NO food-processing machinery, NO lab coats, no CGI look. Illustrative operations image, not a claim to depict an actual company site.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: supporting landscape photograph for the Supply Chain section of a Saudi food company's Operations page. Primary request: a realistic supplier coordination and procurement-material review, showing people and physical materials rather than manufacturing. Scene: a tidy materials receiving station next to a food warehouse in Saudi Arabia, two business colleagues, one Saudi procurement specialist in a plain light-colored shirt and one supplier representative in a plain navy shirt, jointly examining packaging samples and sealed ingredient sample pouches on a simple waist-height worktable. Objects: two blank kraft sample bags, clean plain carton packaging samples, a small sealed transparent food-grade sample container with grain, neatly arranged; no branded finished retail products. Their attention is on the material and its quality, one person holding a small plain carton sample while the other looks at the seam, natural purposeful interaction and believable hands. Soft-focus warehouse racks and neatly stacked plain incoming materials behind them. Composition: one single landscape 3:2 medium-wide editorial photograph, both people and the material samples clearly visible in the center, balanced room for responsive cropping. Lighting and style: natural window daylight, realistic materials and skin textures, warm neutral restrained palette, polished but authentic professional photography. Constraints: NO Masdar logo, NO Fonte logo, NO other logos or company branding, NO words or logos on clothing or packaging or walls. NO chart displays, NO graphs, NO dashboards, NO computers, NO tablets, NO monitors, NO visible screens, NO readable documents, NO readable text or signage, NO watermarks, NO factory conveyor or machinery, NO laboratory coats, NO handshake pose, NO artificial CGI finish. Illustrative procurement scene, not a claim to depict actual company personnel.
